holder-quote: And the Goblin sang and sang. He was crying, laughing, smiling.

effect-quote: Something like actual rest replaced the magic and alchemy.

holder-quote: They had a Level 35 [Bard] and he didn’t so much as hum. Numbtongue crossed his arms. However, Bird happily climbed onto the wagon and began poking him, like a Goblin.
